title: UI/UX Designer Roadmap
description: Become a professional UI/UX Designer. Learn how to design user-friendly interfaces, create prototypes, understand user behavior, and collaborate with developers.

Syllabus.title: Introduction to UI/UX Design
Syllabus.description: Understand the difference between UI and UX and why both are crucial.
Lesson: Role of a UI/UX designer in a team

Syllabus.title: User Research and Empathy
Syllabus.description: Learn to understand user needs and behaviors.

Syllabus.title: Wireframing and Sketching
Syllabus.description: Visualize and plan your design ideas.

Syllabus.title: Visual Design and UI Principles
Syllabus.description: Design interfaces that are visually appealing and consistent.

Syllabus.title: Tools of the Trade
Syllabus.description: Get comfortable with industry-standard UI/UX tools.
Lesson: Notion or Miro for planning and collaboration

Syllabus.title: Prototyping and Interaction Design
Syllabus.description: Create clickable prototypes and interactive flows.

Syllabus.title: Usability Testing
Syllabus.description: Test your design with real users to validate decisions.

Syllabus.title: UX Writing and Accessibility
Syllabus.description: Design for inclusivity and guide users with clear language.
Lesson: Writing clear CTAs and error messages

Syllabus.title: Design Handoff and Collaboration
Syllabus.description: Work with developers and stakeholders effectively.

Syllabus.title: Portfolio Building
Syllabus.description: Create a portfolio that showcases your skills and process.

Syllabus.title: Real-World Projects
Syllabus.description: Build real or mock projects to showcase your capabilities.
Lesson: Redesign a popular app (e.g., Spotify or WhatsApp)
Design a new mobile app UI
Create a responsive landing page UI
Work on freelance or open-source projects
